group_results.reason: Parsing can create nested nodes; destruction of the local document reaches the changed child deletion loop. The loop saves the next sibling before deletion and clears the child's parent before DeleteNode.

Malformed XML can reach XMLDocument::DeleteNode through the parser's error cleanup. That call passes a non-null node, so the changed assertion is reached with its required argument; the null-pointer API case is outside this entry's operations.
